flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/App.tsx, src/i18n/en/translation.json, src/utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts, src/utils/models/Icourtcase.d.ts, src/pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx,hook/useSearch.ts,hook/useSearchParams.tsx,list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx}, src/pages/Notice/{context/NoticeContext.tsx,form/History.tsx}, src/pages/Report/{index.tsx,action/ActionReport.tsx}, src/utils/config/env.ts. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase.java (3 columns) and workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController (inbound CAS, not credited). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court document upload code
note: The court document upload epic has no code in the six repos. Only leftovers exist in ocmsadminui: the label 'Court Upload Documents' in translation.json:105-106, the file rule court_upload_doc (10 MB, Document) in ValidFile.ts:182-185 which no component uses, the Icourtcase type (doc_type, file_name, b_lob, send_to_sc_flag) in Icourtcase.d.ts:41-49 with no upload user in the UI, and an empty '{/* COURT */}' block in App.tsx:313. The OcmsCourtCase entity in ocmsadminapi has only 3 columns (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason; OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31) and is used by the inbound CAS endpoints (CasIntegrationController), not for document upload; the CAS endpoints are not credited because no step of this story matches them. State Courts SFTP/batch is not in the six repos (earlier court epic finding). The status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' is a sheet claim; the code does not support it. There is no court upload flow, so there is no success prompt and no sending to State Courts. There is only the send_to_sc_flag field in the Icourtcase type (Icourtcase.d.ts:41) with no writer or reader, and the 'State Court' label in translation.json:101. Inbound CAS endpoints are not credited.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The success prompt and the sending to State Courts do not exist; the State Courts integration is not in the repos.

steps.step: OCMS shows a prompt that the file was uploaded successfully
steps.detail: There is no court upload flow, so there is no upload success notification. The COURT block in App.tsx:313 is empty; there is no court upload response handler in ocmsadminui and no endpoint in the backend. Success notifications in other features (for example notice number upload) are not credited.

steps.step: The prompt tells the officer the document will be sent to State Courts
steps.detail: There is no prompt text about sending to State Courts. There is only the send_to_sc_flag field in the Icourtcase.d.ts:41 type with no user and the 'State Court' label in translation.json:101.

steps.step: The document is actually sent to State Courts
steps.detail: There is no code that sends documents to State Courts: no State Courts SFTP/batch in ocmsadminprivateapi (grep state court in src/main of the three backend repos: zero hits), thirdpartyapi, or ocmsadminapi. send_to_sc_flag is neither written nor read in the backend (OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31 has no such column). Cannot verify from repo whether that integration exists in another system. The inbound CAS endpoint (CasIntegrationController.java:101 casUpdateCourtNotices) receives updates from CAS, not sends documents, and is not credited.
